subject: Fwd: Client verification request – Athos Insurance
body:
Looping in Jo who handles our accounts.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: service@athosinsurance.com
Subject: Client verification request – Athos Insurance

Hello,

We have a mutual client named Vance Digital, who we are helping to finalize their current insurance needs...

	Have you worked with this client before?
	If yes, what is your history with this client?
notes: A forward with no new content answers nothing. The quoted Athos email must not be read as the rental house's answers.
